previousRegressionBaseline.reason: No host production code changed in this stage. New C processing is independently exercised by native/XP probes and two-backend GPU differential.

scope: Shared fixed-function geometry/copy/range mechanics only. Programmable vertex shaders, multiple input streams, active blend matrices, clipping metadata, fog generation and texture coordinate generation/transforms are subsequent work. The XP probes inspect real COM VB output; GPU drawing is tested separately, not inside that XP probe.
